key_points: Bernstein downgraded PepsiCo to Underperform and cut price target to $128, citing weak North America demand.
North American beverage volume fell 2% in Q3, signaling slowing core sales.
PepsiCo announced 1,000 North American job cuts amid activist pressure, raising cost‑structure concerns.
Quarterly dividend was raised 4% to $1.48 and reaffirmed, supporting shareholder returns.
Consumer staples sector strength and dividend increase may temper downside, but earnings pressure remains.
